profile.name: PVI设备连接器
profile.description: 一种非物理的软件连接组件，用于通过 EPICS PVA 连接并解析 PVI 结构。它会根据类型注解自动创建设备或信号子项，在真实或模拟连接时补全并校验这些子项，供实验控制系统组织和接入基于 PVI 描述的设备对象。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software connector used to access and interpret a PVI structure over EPICS PVA. It auto-creates device or signal children from type hints, then fills and validates them during real or mock connection so laboratory control software can assemble devices described by PVI.

registry.name: B&R Automation Connect to PVI structure served over PVA
registry.description: Pvi Device Connector是由B&R Automation生产的后处理设备，主要功能包括设备连接。支持Signal, Slot, create children from annotations等操作。
